scope: Uncalibrated synthetic application-baseline comparison, no novelty or scientific gate
paired_design: Reuse initial/process/measurement noise and dt across all methods/scenarios at each seed. Single Gaussian constant-velocity truth except explicit instantaneous velocity jump in maneuver scenario. q and R are known; no realistic imaging claim.
methods: fixed-NIS gate before update at every observed time
bounded deferred reacquisition only at first return with one confirmation observation
gate_scope: Fixed squared Mahalanobis threshold, including equality. Do not infer empirical false-alarm calibration. Gate rejects observation but keeps prediction. Deferred algorithm continues immediate updates after confirmation.
primary: Position RMSE across causal outputs at indices 30-39 inclusive. Preserve paired deferred-minus-immediate and deferred-minus-gated errors for every trajectory. Negative lower, exact zero tie. No winner rule.
secondary: Full 80-time position RMSE; NIS gate reject indices; deferred first acceptance and scores; first-return and confirmation position errors; no mixture-calibrated NEES
latency: At time 30 deferred outputs prediction only; at time 31 selected branch is updated, without changing time-30 output. One observation lag; report actual dt31 as confirmation delay in seconds, arbitrary synthetic units.
failure_rule: Abort on any exception, drop no seed. Any post-freeze behavioral change requires new version/disclosure. Evaluation seeds forbidden until approval and publication confirmation.
resources: numpy CPU-only, one BLAS thread, free local execution under 2 cores/2 GB, no training or downloads
